$comment: YouTube Data API quota for automatic posting (D375; PT2 D408). Two models. 'upload-bucket' (the default since PT2): videos.insert has its own daily bucket (uploadBucketPerDay calls a day, not taken from quotaUnitsPerDay); each upload still costs thumbnailUnits from the unit quota. Uploads a day that fit = min(uploadBucketPerDay, floor((quotaUnitsPerDay - readReserveUnits) / (thumbnailUnits + read units))), and never more than 24 (the 60-minute gap). Read units (Codex review 2026-11-21, D409): the channel is read again right before every upload session, so each upload also carries one full read at its worst, 1 + 2 x maxPages (data/posting/schedule.json; 81). 'unit-sum' (the old D375 model, the fallback): each upload costs insertUnits + thumbnailUnits (+ the read units) from the unit quota: floor((10000 - 100) / 1731) = 5. When YouTube answers an upload with quotaExceeded while the bucket model is in use, nothing uploads until the next Pacific midnight (exhaustedUntil), the day's earlier bucket uploads are recounted at insertUnits each, and the app counts the 'unit-sum' way for the rest of that Pacific day and fallbackDays more (a repeated answer never extends this), says so in plain words (task bar and Settings), and tries the bucket model again after (state in <data dir>/posting/quota-model.json). quotaUnitsPerDay is the project's daily quota in Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > YouTube Data API v3 > Quotas); the user's own value lives in <data dir>/posting/schedule.json. Reads: channels.list, playlistItems.list and videos.list cost 1 unit each. Read by services/posting/quota-budget.mjs; never hardcoded.
source: quotaUnitsPerDay 10000 (default allocation), thumbnailUnits 50, read calls 1 unit, and videos.insert in its own bucket of 100 calls a day: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/determine_quota_cost (fetched 2026-11-13; the bucket is UNVERIFIED for this project until a day with more than 6 uploads goes through). model upload-bucket as the default with the quotaExceeded fallback: user 2026-11-21 ('youtube permits upto 100 uploads a day'; plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-posting-text-schedule-growth.md PT2). insertUnits 1600 (fallback model only): docs/plan/2026-11-03-p16b-youtube-private-upload-plan.md. readReserveUnits 100, fallbackDays 1: agent, not a user instruction.
